lenses.finding: Use one headless table engine behind archetype contracts and preserve service-owned business truth.
Fragmented wrappers and query ownership prevent fixes from propagating; consolidate shell, adapters, and tests.
Role/task saved views create more value than broad premium-grid feature parity.
Formalize seven archetypes, one toolbar hierarchy, explicit states, and archetype-specific phone adaptations.
Separate drafts from posted facts; bind bulk actions and exports to reproducible query/evidence scope.
Selection by durable ID, eligibility reasons, and corrections are required for stock-sensitive bulk work.
Saved views, columns, and exports must preserve HRIS/payroll scope, redaction, effective date, and country-pack context.
Route, action, saved-view, selection-token, and export authorization must be independently enforced.
Forbidden fields must not leak through saved-view definitions, counts, URLs, exports, or preference payloads.
Keyboard, focus, announcements, sorting, selection, menus, and responsive alternatives are release gates; no conformance claim is made.
Horizontal scroll alone is insufficient; master, queue, statement, evidence, and editable archetypes need different phone behavior.
Define deterministic server query modes and measured thresholds before virtualization.
Use contract tests, inventory ratchets, approved authenticated route smoke, and evidence manifests.
Cross-module consistency and role defaults reduce onboarding/training cost and increase enterprise trust.
